#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<vector<long long>> mat(n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        mat[i][0] = 1;
        if ((i + 0) % 2 == 1) {
            sum = (sum + mat[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            mat[j][i] = (mat[j][i - 1] + mat[j - 1][i]) % MOD;
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 1) {
                sum = (sum + mat[j][i]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << sum << endl;
    return 0;
}
